climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A cru village in the Montagne de Reims, a Champagne sub-region with chalk-based soils and nine Grands Crus villages. Champagne's sparkling wines are made from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Meunier and a few rarer grapes.
